name: Draw the transparency line
text_content:
Type: founder decision

Source: Session 3 of the Scaling People translation program, page sections 8.4 and 11.2 of the S3 page in the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253. Session task 86ajgmhgx.

Her fourth test of internal communications is transparency: "everyone has clarity about what will be shared, when, and with whom." The record commits to sharing the org chart, the lead, the compensation mechanics, and the advancement path with every candidate before hire, and says nothing about operating figures, individual review content, or the financial model. The team's recommendation: goals, metrics, owners, competency paths, ranges, and the decision-rights register visible to everyone; individual reviews to the person and their domain lead; the financial model and lagging figures to the founders and whoever they name. The founders draw the line.

comment.text: Session 13 met the line's founder-gated half at one figure. A person can check their own pool share by arithmetic only if they can see the day's pool, and a person who can see the pool at a known proportion can compute the day's revenue, which is the lagging figure this line holds. The team recommends that the person sees the whole arithmetic of their own share, the day's pool included, because a share a person cannot check is legible by trust and not by arithmetic and the record's whole answer to the check-line's dishonesty is a mechanism a person can verify; the cost is stated, that every person on the roster can derive the day's revenue, and the alternative is stated, the pay page showing the person's points, the day's total points, and the share, with the pool held. The team also recommends that the percentage's value appears on item 6 and the mechanics page once set, because a mechanism handed "nothing withheld" cannot withhold its central proportion, and that every seat's weights are published to the house, because item 6 already hands them to every candidate. The review record and the pay page are the person's and their lead's and no one else's, inside the line's "review content beyond the person and their lead." S13 page, section 13; P38, P39, P40; readiness row 160.
